newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $110/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $110/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs 109.00 to mostly 110.00 (weighted average 109.61) .
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 109.00 to mostly 110.00. ( weighted average 109.81 ).
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was fairly active on Thursday. Prices both classes steady to $1.00 higher on a live basis. Buyer inquiry good, seller interest mixed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 66.00-67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1225 lbs 66.00-67.00.

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis steady to mostly $1.00 higher, dressed basis $2.00-$3.00 higher. Weekly total includes 5,000 formulated and/or previously contracted cattle. Confirmed - 11,700 Last Week - 7,700 Last Year - 14,000 Wk To Date- 34,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 56,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 59,200
